method: Native GH document dataflow and button pulses in a separate Rhino GUI process; real external Python workers. Every canonical graph executed once, with archive acceptance for duplicate GHX/manual copies.
scope: All 21 canonical examples and 11 lesson files.
Lesson geometry references and intentional starter gaps supplied in memory only; source exercise files were not rewritten.
Saved CPU defaults used, including shelf bracket: CPU AMG, 5 mm grid, threshold .35, 60 iterations, four independent load cases.
Former 2.5 mm shelf candidate remains an unqualified advanced refinement: substantially slower on CPU and historical automatic surface-meshing failure.
Iteration limits are not convergence. One final FEM mesh is not a mesh-convergence study or structural certification.
